hover-dev-77c2d907d817.summaryZh: 深色背景上一枚电光紫蓝的圆角矩形按钮，底边垂下数条粗细不一的漆滴，末端带圆头，像刚刷完未干的油漆正在往下淌。白色 Poppins 粗体字居中，圆角仅 4px，整体是扁平色块加有机液态轮廓的对比。
hover-dev-77c2d907d817.summaryEn: On a near-black backdrop sits an electric indigo rounded rectangle whose bottom edge sags into several uneven paint drips with rounded tips, as if freshly brushed and still wet. Centered white Poppins semibold text, only 4px radius, contrasting a flat colour block with an organic liquid silhouette.
hover-dev-77c2d907d817.motionZh: 悬停时漆滴被拉长并分离出独立的圆点向下坠落，1.2 秒后滴点继续下移并淡出，形成持续的滴漆循环。
hover-dev-77c2d907d817.motionEn: On hover the drips stretch and detach into separate round droplets that fall downward; 1.2s later the droplets continue descending and fade out, looping as a continuous dripping animation.
hover-dev-77c2d907d817.useZh: 适合创意工作室、设计工具或潮流品牌的落地页主行动按钮。
hover-dev-77c2d907d817.useEn: Fits a hero CTA for a creative studio, design tool, or streetwear brand landing page.
hover-dev-77c2d907d817.prompt: Build a dark-page CTA button: background #615fff, white Poppins 600 16px text, padding 10px 16px, border-radius 4px, transition 0.15s. Add an SVG/CSS pseudo-element along the bottom edge forming 4-5 uneven drips with rounded caps. On hover, animate drips stretching downward and detaching into circular droplets that fall and fade, looping infinitely with staggered delays per drip. Keep the label static and centered.

hover-dev-b85564df2672.summaryZh: 三张高饱和撞色卡片并排，每张内部叠放巨大的黑色几何形（圆、圆角方、尖角菱形），像拼贴海报一样压在文字下方。价格用超大粗体白字压住图形，顶部有半透明胶囊标签，底部是等宽字体的白色按钮。
hover-dev-b85564df2672.summaryEn: Three saturated colour cards sit side by side, each layered with a huge black geometric shape — a circle, a rounded square, a pointed diamond — collaged behind the text like a poster. Oversized bold white pricing type overlaps the shapes, a translucent pill label sits top-left, and a monospace white button anchors the bottom.
hover-dev-b85564df2672.motionZh: 悬停时第一张卡的黑色圆形放大并溢出卡片边界，同时按钮由纯白变为带光晕的灰色渐变并出现描边。
hover-dev-b85564df2672.motionEn: On hover the first card's black circle scales up and overflows the card edges, while its button shifts from solid white to a glowing grey gradient with a visible outline.
hover-dev-b85564df2672.useZh: 适合创意机构、SaaS 或设计工具的高冲击力定价页。
hover-dev-b85564df2672.useEn: Fits a high-impact pricing page for a creative agency, SaaS product or design tool.
hover-dev-b85564df2672.prompt: Three side-by-side pricing cards on a dark page, each a rounded rectangle in a different saturated hue: electric blue-violet, bright purple, and hot pink. Inside each card a large black geometric shape is collaged behind the content — a circle, a rounded square, and a pointed diamond respectively. A translucent pill label sits top-left, an oversized bold white price headline overlaps the black shape, muted white body copy sits below, and a full-width white monospace uppercase button anchors the bottom. On hover the first card's black circle scales up and overflows the card boundary, and its button becomes a glowing grey gradient with an outline.

hover-dev-d49dc0cd0420.summaryZh: 深色星空底上铺满细密星点，底部由紫罗兰渐变过渡到深蓝，中央超大无衬线标题带金属银灰渐变，胶囊按钮外裹一圈柔和光晕，整体像夜空中的发光招牌。
hover-dev-d49dc0cd0420.summaryEn: A deep night-sky canvas speckled with fine stars, its lower half washed in a violet-to-blue gradient. An oversized sans-serif headline carries a metallic silver sheen, while a pill button sits inside a soft halo of light, reading like a glowing signboard in the dark.
hover-dev-d49dc0cd0420.motionZh: 背景渐变在约一秒多的时间里由紫罗兰整体漂移为深蓝，星点与文字保持不动，形成缓慢的呼吸式色相流动。
hover-dev-d49dc0cd0420.motionEn: Across the two frames the background gradient drifts from violet toward deep blue while the stars, headline and button stay fixed, producing a slow breathing hue shift.
hover-dev-d49dc0cd0420.useZh: 适合 SaaS 或开发者工具官网首屏，用氛围感背景承接转化按钮。
hover-dev-d49dc0cd0420.useEn: Fits a SaaS or developer-tool landing page hero, using atmospheric backdrop to carry the conversion button.
hover-dev-d49dc0cd0420.prompt: A full-bleed dark hero section on a starry night background: scattered tiny star dots over near-black, with a soft violet-to-blue gradient rising from the bottom edge. Centered stack: a small rounded pill badge reading a short beta label, a very large bold sans-serif headline in two lines with a metallic silver gradient fill, a two-line muted grey subheading, and a pill-shaped outlined call-to-action button with a trailing arrow icon wrapped in a soft outer glow. The gradient hue slowly drifts between violet and blue while all other elements remain static.

hover-dev-ffad57a7427d.summaryZh: 深色背景上一枚正圆头像，内部由多层同心圆环叠成，从中心亮紫向外逐渐变暗，边缘带柔和紫色光晕；正中是白色双斜块标志，整体像水波扩散的发光徽章。
hover-dev-ffad57a7427d.summaryEn: A perfectly circular avatar on a dark backdrop, built from concentric rings that fade from bright violet at the centre to deeper purple outward, with a soft violet glow bleeding past the edge. A white double-parallelogram mark sits at the centre, giving it the feel of a glowing ripple badge.
hover-dev-ffad57a7427d.motionZh: 悬停时圆环整体变亮、光晕增强，随后动画帧中同心圆环向外扩张扩散，形成持续的水波脉冲效果。
hover-dev-ffad57a7427d.motionEn: On hover the rings brighten and the outer glow intensifies; in the later frame the concentric rings expand outward, producing a continuous ripple pulse.
hover-dev-ffad57a7427d.useZh: 适合作为深色主题产品、AI 工具或社区应用的品牌头像与加载标识。
hover-dev-ffad57a7427d.useEn: Fits as a brand avatar or loading mark for dark-theme products, AI tools, or community apps.
hover-dev-ffad57a7427d.prompt: A circular avatar on a near-black background, formed by several concentric rings of purple that brighten toward the centre and fade outward, with a soft violet glow spilling beyond the circle. A white double-parallelogram glyph sits dead centre. On hover the rings light up and the glow grows; a later frame shows the rings expanding outward as a ripple pulse.

hover-dev-c4fb5a61b31b.summaryZh: 整体是一条细黑描边的全圆角胶囊容器，内部等距排列大写无衬线标签，字距舒展、留白充裕。选中项以实心黑胶囊反白文字呈现，与容器描边形成黑白双层的极简对比。
hover-dev-c4fb5a61b31b.summaryEn: A fully rounded pill container drawn with a thin black outline holds evenly spaced uppercase sans-serif labels with generous letter spacing. The active item becomes a solid black pill with reversed white text, creating a crisp two-layer black-and-white contrast against the outlined shell.
hover-dev-c4fb5a61b31b.motionZh: 悬停时黑色实心胶囊滑到指针所在的标签下方，文字由黑转白，其余标签保持描边容器内的黑色文字。
hover-dev-c4fb5a61b31b.motionEn: On hover the solid black pill slides beneath the pointed label and its text flips from black to white, while the remaining labels stay black inside the outlined shell.
hover-dev-c4fb5a61b31b.useZh: 适合极简品牌官网、作品集或产品落地页的顶部主导航切换。
hover-dev-c4fb5a61b31b.useEn: Suits top-level navigation switching on minimal brand sites, portfolios or product landing pages.
hover-dev-c4fb5a61b31b.prompt: A horizontal pill-shaped tab bar with a thin black outline on a white background, containing evenly spaced uppercase sans-serif labels. The active tab is a solid black pill with white reversed text that slides horizontally to sit under the hovered label; inactive labels remain black on white. Generous letter spacing, roomy padding, fully rounded ends, flat and monochrome with no gradients or shadows.

entry-shadcn-studio-blocks-b6b7ef18a85f.summaryZh: 纯黑背景上以点阵构成深蓝地球，外发光晕与细轨道弧线环绕；左侧为白色标题与四张半透明深灰数据卡，卡片带浅色描边和微弱内发光，主按钮为电光蓝胶囊配2px同色外环。
entry-shadcn-studio-blocks-b6b7ef18a85f.summaryEn: A pure-black hero with a dotted deep-blue globe wrapped in a soft cyan halo and thin orbital arcs. Left side stacks a white headline, muted grey subcopy, and four translucent dark stat cards with hairline borders and faint inner glow; the primary CTA is an electric-blue pill with a 2px same-hue ring.
entry-shadcn-studio-blocks-b6b7ef18a85f.motionZh: 地球缓慢自转，轨道弧线与光晕随之漂移，节点脉冲闪烁；按钮悬停时轻微缩放并加深蓝色外环。
entry-shadcn-studio-blocks-b6b7ef18a85f.motionEn: The globe rotates slowly, its orbital arcs and halo drifting with it while node dots pulse; the primary button scales slightly on hover and its blue ring deepens.
entry-shadcn-studio-blocks-b6b7ef18a85f.useZh: 适合 AI、SaaS 或数据基础设施产品的落地页首屏，用于强调全球覆盖与自动化能力。
entry-shadcn-studio-blocks-b6b7ef18a85f.useEn: Fits the landing-page hero of an AI, SaaS, or data-infrastructure product that wants to stress global reach and automation.
entry-shadcn-studio-blocks-b6b7ef18a85f.prompt: Build a dark hero section on #000000. Center a pill badge with 1px white border, then a 48-56px white Geist headline and a #a1a1a1 subline. Add two CTAs: primary pill bg #0084d1, white 16px/500 text, radius 14px, padding 0 24px, box-shadow 0 0 0 2px #0084d1, transition transform 0.2s; secondary ghost pill with transparent bg, 1px #ffffff33 border, radius 14px, plus a right arrow. Below, a 2x2 grid of stat cards: bg rgba(255,255,255,0.04), 1px #ffffff1a border, radius 16px, icon + label row then a bold 40px value. Right column holds a dotted-globe image with a radial cyan glow and slowly rotating orbit arcs (CSS keyframes, ~40s linear infinite).
